facts.fact: 黑屏后醒来：无伤、丝裙无污、疤痕都在——「So I brought myself with me」；凡人的身体死了。
无纱初见：奶油色亚麻衫、笑着的他——她用手指的屋顶地图确认（下颌转折/鼻/眉/嘴角傲气）——「Hello, my flower.」
规则摊牌：之前每世她死他都不能接——需要她死前说 yes，是「意图」决定能否认领；「He tried everything a god can try that isn't force and nothing worked」——她的 plan 恰好是唯一合规路径。
facts.anchor: he needed me to say yes before I died

facts.fact: 他全听见了（公园/教堂/街头喊名如疯妇）——没来是怕重启轮回（那版她犹疑）；「when you jumped… I grabbed your soul the moment it detached from your mortal body.」
「你懂我站在一旁听你坠落、听你颅骨裂开、血肉散落街头有多贵吗？」——她抓住他衬衫：「You were there.」她从未真正孤单。
他没收她的道歉：「You are done… I will not tolerate you feeling as though you did something wrong.」「That's the nicest threat anyone's ever made.」「It was a promise.」
facts.anchor: You have apologized too many times already

facts.fact: 书房：1,003 封信=1,003 世，每封附当世她最爱的花（the flower in each is the one you loved best that life）；「I wasn't able to give you my voice or the truth, I gave you the only thing I could leave behind.」——她哭倒：「你把它们全塞进了罐子。」「You kept them… You have no idea what that did to me.」

花园：她每世挑过的花全种着、百年不谢（「I would not let them」）；她的病名确诊——「Homesick. For a home I'd never been to or knew existed.」「You are home. Say it back to me.」「I'm home… Thank you. For not giving up.」「There was never any version of this where I did not come back to you.」
